method.positive_detection: A Markdown physical line outside ``` or ~~~ code fences and headings, containing one or more English MUST/SHALL/REQUIRED/NEVER/PROHIBITED/SHOULD or selected Chinese obligation/prohibition phrases; any one line is one candidate
method.sampling: All 46 source documents counted; examples store first 40 matching lines in changed documents, first 5 otherwise; rest count preserved. Each example anchored by line and Git blob.
method.caveat: NOT an atomic obligation inventory; one line can contain multiple distinct rules or none. Unmarked implicit normative rules omitted. Structured tables may appear.
